applicability: Fusing two conditionally-independent angular estimates (IMU heading, acoustic DOA) of the same true heading, already expressed in a shared sign convention
assumptions: both angles already share the same coordinate/sign convention
small-angle regime for the circular approximation to the true von Mises fusion
excluded: non-Gaussian or multimodal (e.g. front-back ambiguous) DOA error
uncertainty: Declared standard deviations are taken as given, not measured or calibrated here. A near-180-degree disagreement is flagged, not resolved.
limits_policy: Explicit caller-declared timestamp-skew and fused-precision limits, not a presumed standard.
